ledger: Man in blue suit (glasses, red tie, yellow pocket square) | leaning in from left, placing coins into cups | standing behind table shuffling cups with both hands | leans over table during setup, then rises and shuffles

Red metal cups with silver interiors | four cups on table (back, center, right, bottom-left), two containing gold coins | only three cups visible during the shuffle | one cup disappears from the table between 0:04 and 0:06

Gold coins | scattered on patterned table border, coins inside center and bottom-left cups, one pinched in hand | coins remain on border, hands shuffling cups on top | coins placed into cups, one extracted and held at 0:04

findings.description: Four cups are clearly visible on the table from 0:00 through 0:04 (back, center, right, and bottom-left). From 0:06 onward, and through the shuffle at 0:08, only three cups are present. No cup is ever shown being picked up and removed — both of the man's hands stay on/near the remaining cups the whole time — so the fourth cup vanishes without explanation.
